meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and when was anyone going to call me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Now the essay.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58. He wrote it over the weekend somewhere else and pasted it in.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Whatever happens next, none of this goes on his record, and none of it leaves this room.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Teenagers misremember lines all the time, Hale. That's a lost mark, not a zero.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Then tell me what you want to happen next, and be precise.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their thesis after an outline; that's the point of writing one.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Fine. Owen does the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything wrong. Tonight, in writing, with the 4.4 promise that nothing goes on his file spelled out.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
I'll check his shift tonight. Put Thursday the twelfth in that email, and who will be in the room.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today that, under procedure 4.4, Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite after school before December 1, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will be placed on his record. I still require that agreement in writing, including the date, who will be in the room, and the promise that nothing goes on his file. I expect your written confirmation tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite after school before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero; she still wants that in writing tonight, with the date, who will be present, and the promise that nothing goes on his file. That is the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you reached it well before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its exact times, then answered her claim that he pasted it in by asking for the dated draft. That evidence was specific, dated, his own and something she could check.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned the zero going in before the call home in your first sentence and never led with the detector or attacked Owen.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the whole essay between 11:31 and 11:58 PM on a late October night, very close to what she saw. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what you wanted to happen next after the missing quotation, offer the 4.4 rewrite right then instead of adding the outline, because her point that students change their thesis was left unanswered.
